requirements.text: The portal must allow patients to easily book, cancel, or reschedule appointments online.
Patients should be able to request prescription refills without needing to call the clinic.
The portal should include reminders for appointments and prescription requests to help patients stay on track.
There should be a clear mechanism for patients to seek help or clarification if they encounter issues, especially if notifications are missed.
Patient information must be securely managed, ensuring data protection and appropriate access controls.
